figurative_meaning_en: being astonished or surprised with mouth agape
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে অদ্ভুত দৃশ্য দেখে হাঁ করে তাকিয়ে রইল।
খবর শুনে সবাই হাঁ করে শুনল।
example_sentences_in_english: He stared with his mouth open at the strange sight.
Everyone listened with mouth agape upon hearing the news.
note: This idiom vividly captures the physical reaction to surprise in Bengali expressive language.
